# `company.landed_cost_carries`

A receipt a landed cost lands on, restated unchanged by an edit of its document (a memo, a reference): its landed cost carries on to the restatement.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this immutable carry. |
| `from_movement_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique | — | inventory_movements.id | Receipt movement a document change retired with its stock unchanged. |
| `to_movement_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | inventory_movements.id | The receipt movement that restated it and carries its landed cost on. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this carry was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this carry. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this carry. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this carry. |
